resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS says the first and only structure dates from 1934, but the December 1924 wire notice and the 1928 record both refer to a Pony Peak Lookout. The sources do not say what stood on the peak before 1934.

notes_for_editor: Only the foundation is described today; no source states access or whether the peak is open to visitors. The 1951 Pony Peak Fire (about 4,900 acres near Cottage Grove, per a wildfire lessons-learned page) shares the peak's name, but no source ties it to the lookout, so it is left out. The 1924 and 1928 references to a Pony Peak Lookout predate the 1934 cabin FFLOS calls the first structure; the story says so without resolving it. Staffing dates come from the register, not an official roster. No photos added: captions only (a 1925 temporary-site photo on FFLOS; a 1925 photo credit on the Siskiyou County page), and no image URLs were retrieved.
